title: The S.S. Freedom Returns to Campus
summary: On Wednesday, March 18, 2015—the morning after Judge Vance dismissed Aubrie Sinclair's guardianship petition with prejudice—Jordan rolls across the CPI Drillfield at the helm of the matte-black Titan-X350 ('S.S. Freedom'), returning to his astronomy, physics, and Roman history lectures, ordering lunch in the crowded campus food court without fear, and celebrating six-week sternal clearance back in Room 214.
